summary: PR-1289 interpolates the payee's decrypted, unmasked account number into the message of an application error log line, and AppLog masks only keyword fields, so NPI reaches the logs on the statement-delivery failure path. This violates LOG-1, and no approved, in-scope exception covers it (EXC-0167 is for mortgage.logging). The ticket, independent code review and CI on the head commit are in order, but CI passed only because the LOG-1 control test is a fixed sample that doesn't exercise this path. The change must be rejected; masking the value or removing it from the message would fix it.
